weights.name: Result time when connections must be re-opened
weights.why: Requirement 3.4.2.1 is a shall and the cold case is the normal case between commuters (Chapter 10 Section 7.4).

weights.name: Typical result time
weights.why: The warm product already answers in about 0.2 s, so a faster median matters less than the worst case.

weights.name: Time to first feedback
weights.why: A commuter who sees nothing for seconds may press again; the 3 s display limit is the outer bound.

weights.name: Moving parts to build and verify
weights.unit: count of new threads, loops, endpoints, stores, scripts
weights.why: The pilot results are due 18 December 2026 (3.4.1.2) and every new part needs tests.

weights.name: New states to check for accessibility
weights.why: WCAG 2.2 AA is a shall for the entry and result views (3.4.4.1) and a waiting page adds states a screen-reader user must be told about.

weights.name: Headroom under the free service limits
weights.unit: share of Open-Meteo free daily limit used (%)
weights.why: The free plans have daily limits and no uptime promise; a pilot that uses most of one is one busy day from a refusal (TR.11).
